% A document with titletoc's partial table of contents, list of figures,
% and list of tables, beside the .ptc, .plf, and .plt of an earlier build
% and its .aux, which names them in \ttl@writefile lines. The earlier
% build had no entries in them: each holds titletoc's \ttl@starttoc and
% an \addtocontents write of \oldmark, which this document does not
% define. titletoc reads these files with \@input when it prints them.
% The stale files stay as they are.
\documentclass{article}
\usepackage{titletoc}
\begin{document}
\section{First}
\startcontents
\printcontents{}{1}{}
\startlist{lof}
\printlist{lof}{}{}
\startlist{lot}
\printlist{lot}{}{}
Text of the first section.
\subsection{New subsection}
Text of the subsection.
\begin{figure}[h]
\centering A figure.
\caption{New figure}
\end{figure}
\begin{table}[h]
\centering A table.
\caption{New table}
\end{table}
\end{document}
